arcades.info_text: This info is as of 29th July 2011. / There are two DS EM1 machines - one of them has a EM2 sign on it. Don't be fooled! The downstairs one has mega-loud bass and is 4 songs a go. They are both reasonably loud - in fact the downstairs one can be heard from outside! However, the pads aren't very good, which is what can be expected. They have gotten considerably worse however, and the staff have so far refused to fix them because "technically, they still work". I have managed to pass the hardest songs on them though and some people I have seen have even FC'd (albeit on basic). And of course, if you play anything above a 5 foot then you get a big crowd! / There's also a Guitar Hero. I'm rubbish at Guitar Hero so I didn't play it, but it seemed to work well from what I saw watching other people play it. / The overall quality of the machines is mediocre. Every machine is slowly dying, and the staff seem not to care. They still have the machines on so they take your money, and only then do you discover that the machine is broken.

Many pinball machines and a few cabs hosting retro titles. Pretty cool place to hang. / Utilizes a top-up card system for payment and ticket collection. £1 per 10 tokens, with bulk discounts beginning at £25.

As well as being in good condition, there is quite a few that you don't usually see around as much! / This used to be called Starbowl however was closed and taken over by Lane 7, who have completely turned it around. Before the take over it was pretty much a wasteland, so it's great that they've made it such a lively place. / Edit 02/08/2023: / The arcade has switched to a card system, with a Bay Tek redemption machine for prizes.
